checks.description: Retargeting during glide should continue from the current pitch; overlapping keys must not restart amp.

behavior: Only the gate rise at 0 s produces key.trigger. New presses at 0.5 s and 0.55 s keep gate at 1 and send no trigger.
At 0.5 s, a 100 ms glide begins from pitch 69 to 72, linear in semitones.
At 0.55 s, key.pitch is 70.5. A new 100 ms glide targets 74 and reaches it at 0.65 s.
Releasing D5 at 0.75 s glides back to C5, reaching 72 at 0.85 s. Releasing C5 at 0.95 s glides back to A4, reaching 69 at 1.05 s.
The last key releases at 1.2 s; the 300 ms Release finishes at 1.5 s.
